messages:
alina: Quick planning thread — aiming for Friday 22:00 UTC release window (2h). We want a staggered rollout: runtime-api + serving-runtime first (to warm caches), then web-ui, then analytics/console. Please claim a lane and confirm smoke + rollback readiness. Ops will apply pipeline lock at 21:30 UTC.

mike: I can take runtime-api deploy and smoke. I’ll coordinate with @samir for config drift checks. :raised_hands:

samir: ack, I’ll pre-apply config patch and run the config-validation job at 20:45. Will post results.

dena: I’ll own serving-runtime (GPU pool). Plan: start node warmup at 21:40, run small inference sanity, then scale to 80% before traffic. Smoke owner: me.

lee: I can take web-ui. I’ll do canary to 5% then 25% after 10m if all good. Smoke checklist below.

jordan: analytics + console assigned to me. I’ll queue data-backfill blockers earlier today and ensure schema migrations are backward-compatible.

alina: Nice — stagger schedule (estimated): 22:00 runtime-api/serving start, 22:12 web-ui canary, 22:30 analytics/console start. If any lane fails smoke, rollback immediately and abort downstream lanes.

mike: Smoke checklist (quick):
```
- deploy to canary host
- run /health and /metrics (ok)
- 5 sample inference requests (latency < 120ms)
- KV cache warmup check
- validate logs for errors
```

lee: Web UI smoke snippet:
```
- build tag: `release/247-wk12`
- smoke script: `./smoke/web-smoke.sh --target canary`
- quick ux flows: login, workspace load, prompt send
```

dena: Rollback points: we’ll use git tags + image tags. Example rollback tag for runtime: `rollback/runtime/2026-03-19-rc1`. Make sure deploy run includes `--previous-img` in pipeline in case we need insta-rollback.

ops-bot: pipeline-lock will be applied at 2470000000+21:30 UTC (approx). To request unlock, ping @alina with justification.

tanya: Quick ask — anyone blocked by PR reviews? I have one small infra PR that needs approval to enable warmup scripts.

samir: I’ll review tanya’s PR at 17:30 and leave comments.

alina: Final asks:
- Post smoke results in this thread (short summary)
- If you claim a lane, add your name + smoke owner + rollback tag below
- Keep the deploy commands idempotent and annotate any manual steps

mike: Claiming runtime-api — smoke owner: mike — rollback tag: `rollback/runtime/2026-03-19-rc1`. I’ll post smoke results after 22:05. :rocket:

dena: Claiming serving-runtime — smoke owner: dena — rollback tag: `rollback/serving/2026-03-19-rc1`.

lee: Claiming web-ui — smoke owner: lee — rollback tag: `rollback/webui/2026-03-19-rc1`.

jordan: Claiming analytics/console — smoke owner: jordan — rollback tag: `rollback/analytics/2026-03-19-rc1`.

alina: Great. I’ll be on-call for coordination and escalation. If anyone expects a longer smoke or needs more time, flag it now so we can re-slot. Otherwise, see you Friday 22:00 UTC. :calendar:
